ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creates UIAF financial intelligence unit); Ley 1121 de 2006 (national AML/CFT framework); Ley 2155 de 2021 Art. 57 (UBO reporting mandate); Decreto 830 de 2021 (regulates identification of Beneficiario Final); Resolución DIAN No. 164 de 2021 (UBO registry declaration procedure); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES); Circular Básica Jurídica de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (LA/FT risk management).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport (or cédula de extranjería) of each UBO and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or consular officer in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incorporation of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of shareholder's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney granting incorporation authority to the local Colombian attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in country of origin and/or Colombian consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado de homonimia (name clearance certificate from RUES)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio via RUES portal

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of UBOs, directors, and legal representatives against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian UIAF 'Lista de Riesgo', and Colombian judicial conviction databases. Enhanced due diligence is triggered by any PEP status, adverse media, or sanctions hit. Screening results must be documented, retained for five years, and made available to the Superintendencia de Sociedades upon request. Domestic and foreign-source funds must be traceable to licensed banking channels; cash contributions above statutory thresholds require additional source of funds evidence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co), operated by the 57 Colombian Cámaras de Comercio; name inquiry conducted via the 'consulta de nombre' module.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script (Spanish alphabet). Non-Latin names (e.g., Japanese or Cyrillic) must be transliterated into phonetically decipherable Spanish/Latin characters. The suffix 'S.A.S.' is mandatory for this entity type. Foreign-language words are permissible only in Latin script and where they do not mislead as to the company's nature or create confusion with regulated activities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Departamento or municipio names without prior authorization
Términos contrarios al orden público o las buenas costumbres
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name inquiry is rejected due to identical or confusingly similar existing registrations, the applicant may immediately file a new name inquiry on RUES at no additional cost. Within ten business days of the formal rejection notice, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) with the issuing Cámara de Comercio, and a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio. A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional thirty-day term if requested before expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible as the registered company domicile (domicilio principal) for S.A.S. administrative and service-of-process purposes, provided the address is functional and staffed or contracted to receive judicial and administrative correspondence. However, the high-precision injection molding manufacturing plant must be registered separately as an establecimiento de comercio with its own physical address, zoning certification, and municipal operating compliance; a purely virtual office cannot host the industrial machinery or satisfy labor and environmental site requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection is approximately 10–15% within the first 12 months of registration for a low-risk ISIC 3240 facility, based on DIAN territorial verification programs, municipal zoning patrols, and labor safety visits; probability rises if competitor complaints, customs revenue anomalies, or community zoning objections are recorded.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1-5, 18-20 (incorporation by private deed, capital and payment terms); Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 110-116 and 372 (merchant registration); Decreto 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.38.1 et seq. (RUES registration); Estatuto Tributario (Decreto 624 de 1989), arts. 19 and 555-2 (RUT/NIT); Ley 223 de 1995, art. 227 (impuesto de registro).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (private incorporation deed and bylaws) filed with the Chamber of Commerce; no public deed is required unless real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a S.A.S. (Ley 1258/2008, art. 5). Cash contributions may be deferred for up to 24 months after registration; in-kind contributions must be paid at execution. No court-supervised escrow account is required; the subscribed capital is deposited in a Colombian corporate bank account and documented for the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN and Banco de la República. Non-residents may own 100% of the shares and must appoint a resident legal representative.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF MECHA MODEL KIT S.A.S. — ADOPTED ON [DATE].
The founding shareholders hereby resolve:
1. Share Subscription. Subscription of 100 common shares of COP 1,000 each (subscribed capital COP 100,000) is ratified. Each shareholder's contribution is accepted; the outstanding balance shall be paid within 24 months of RUES registration under Article 5, Law 1258/2008.
2. Registered Office. The principal domicile and registered address is adopted as [precise address], Bogotá D.C., for all corporate, tax, and judicial notices.
3. Officer Appointments. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative (President) with fullest representation powers; [Name] is appointed compliance officer responsible for tax (RUT) and environmental filings; [Name] is appointed Deputy Legal Representative.
This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RUES online portal operated by the Chamber of Commerce (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a homonimia search on the RUES website to verify the proposed corporate name 'MECHA MODEL KIT S.A.S.' is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Submit the name reservation request, pay the nominal reservation fee, and obtain a name reservation certificate valid for 30 business days. Ensure the corporate name ends with 'S.A.S.'.
required_dossiers: RUT or ID of the petitioner/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected because of similarity, submit a written appeal to the Chamber's Comité de Similitud within 5 business days attaching trademark registrations or market differentiation justification, or select an alternative name and re-apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Signature Legalization of the Private Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public or Chamber of Commerce authentication service (autenticación de firmas) via the Ventanilla Única Empresarial
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos under Law 1258/2008, arts. 5 and 18. Each shareholder executes the document in person or through an attorney-in-fact. Signatures must be notarized only if real property is contributed; otherwise a private document signed by all shareholders is sufficient. Foreign shareholders may sign abroad and must apostille their powers of attorney or execution pages and provide a Spanish translation.
required_dossiers: Valid ID or passport copy of each shareholder
Power of attorney with apostille (if applicable)
Pre-RUT form (if not deferred to registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber rejects the document for missing legalization or defective translation, rectify the deficiency (re-apostille, re-translate, re-notarize) and resubmit within the indicated term; no additional registry tax is due if the economic content is unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registration, RUES Filing, and Payment of Registration and Registry Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES) and territorial tax offices (impuesto de registro)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Documento Privado de Constitución together with the completed Formulario Único de Registro via the VUE portal. Pay the Chamber's registration fee and the State impuesto de registro (0.7% of subscribed capital). After the registrar's verification, obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal; the NIT is pre-assigned through DIAN's automatic transmission.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (executed and signature-legalized)
Receipts of payment of registration fees and impuesto de registro
ID/passport copies of shareholders and legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a requerimiento due to inconsistencies between the deed and the form, file a corrective enmienda within 10 business days using the 'Corrección de matrícula' procedure with the amended document and pay the adjustment fee; a negative decision may be appealed to the Chamber's legal office and thereafter to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Activation — NIT and RUT Update Before the DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — MUISCA online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, access MUISCA to activate the pre-assigned NIT, confirm RUT data (legal name, address, CIIU 3240, IVA status at 19%, income tax regime), and obtain the legal representative's electronic signature. Activate electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) with a DIAN-certified solution before the first commercial sale.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT Form or RUT update certificate
Legal representative's identity document (cédula or cédula de extranjería)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT update (e.g., CIIU mismatch), correct the certificate at the Chamber of Commerce and re-file the RUT via MUISCA; if the electronic signature fails, re-validate the legal representative's identity at a DIAN point of contact.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account, Capital Contribution, and Foreign Investment Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks subject to SARLAFT rules (e.g., Banco de Bogotá, Bancolombia, BBVA), and Banco de la República (foreign exchange regime)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the company's name and deposit at least the paid-up fraction of the subscribed capital. Provide the bank with final beneficial ownership information (UBO) and the company's economic profile. If foreign direct investment enters through the foreign exchange market, file the Declaración de Inversión Internacional (Form 3) through an authorized FX intermediary within 6 months; retain bank deposit receipts as capital evidence.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional documents (business plan, lease contract), provide them promptly; if the FX declaration is late, file a late declaration and pay the fines established under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83; if the bank rejects the application, transfer the account to a regulated digital SME banking provider.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (books), municipal Secretariat of Finance (ICA – Impuesto de Industria y Comercio), ARL and social security administrators, and municipal planning office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company's account books, share registry, and minutes book at the Chamber of Commerce before use. Register the establishment for ICA tax and obtain the land use certificate confirming industrial compatibility. Enroll the company with an ARL for industrial risk class and implement the Occupational Health and Safety System (SGSST) before hiring operations scale up.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease contract or property title to the facility
ARL and social security enrollment forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ICA registration is blocked because the land use certificate does not permit industrial activity, apply to the Curaduría Urbana for a specific land use review or relocate the facility; if book registration is returned, correct the ledger headings and re-register on the same day with payment of the nominal re-registration fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No national factory operating license is issued for ISIC 3240 toy manufacturing in Colombia. The regulatory authorities are the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for product technical conformity under Resolución 1454 de 2012 of the Ministry of Health and Social Protection, and the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism (MinCIT) for market surveillance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt — no separate statutory operating permit. The action figure kits must obtain the 'Certificado de Conformidad de Juguetes' under Resolución 1454/2012 before commercialization, and the facility must hold the municipal 'Registro de Industria y Comercio' (ICA), the 'Certificado de Uso de Suelo', and the 'Certificado Técnico de Bomberos'.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) of the project's domicile (regional environmental authority), with the Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) applicable only when Decree 1076 of 2015 Annex II thresholds are exceeded.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Registration — Full EIA license not required for standard injection molding toy plants below Decree 1076/2015 Annex II capacity thresholds. The facility must obtain the applicable environmental permits: 'Permiso de Vertimientos' (wastewater discharge permit), 'Plan de Gestión de Residuos Peligrosos' (hazardous waste management plan) if hazardous waste is generated, and 'Registro de Generador de Residuos' before the competent environmental authority; a preliminary 'Diagnóstico Ambiental' is prepared to confirm the category.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: comply with Resolución 0631 de 2015 point-source discharge limits for the general manufacturing sector (e.g., pH 6.0–9.0, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L where applicable). Air emissions: obey Resolución 909 de 2008 stationary-source limits for particulate matter, VOCs and combustion gases, and Resolución 2254 de 2017 ambient air quality standards; molding cooling circuits must not discharge heated water exceeding permitted temperature elevation without a permit. Plastic scrap and molding waste must be segregated and recycled or valorized; hazardous residues (solvents, oils) must be managed exclusively by licensed handlers under Ley 1252 de 2008.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Mandatory: 'Certificado Técnico de Bomberos' issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos of the municipality (inspection of evacuation routes, extinguishers, fire alarms, and fire-load compliance under NSR-10); 'Certificado de Uso de Suelo' from the municipal planning department confirming industrial zoning; occupational health and safety program (SGSST) registered with the ARL under Decreto 1072/2015 and Resolución 0312/2019 for the industrial risk class; municipal civil protection and emergency response plan; and for any building modification, review by a qualified structural engineer under NSR-10 before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); home portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: Muisca (muisca.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Execute and notarize the SAS deed of incorporation, register the company with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio), and obtain the business registry certificate. Step 2: Complete DIAN Pre-RUT (Pre-Registro Único Tributario) through the Muisca web portal; DIAN will assign a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Step 3: Submit the final RUT registration confirming tax classification as a responsible VAT taxpayer/IVA-responsible SAS, the applicable ISIC 3240 economic activity, and export status. Step 4: Receive the definitive NIT certificate and, where required, activate electronic invoicing authorization. Step 5: For a non-resident foreign entity without a local branch or permanent establishment, the legal representative must obtain an NIT and complete RUT registration through a general power of attorney; no separate shareholder tax ID is required for passive ownership of the SAS.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. An SAS is mandatorily taxed at the entity level under the ordinary national corporate income tax. Relevant statutory elections and regimes include: (i) free trade zone user status obtaining DIAN and ProColombia approval under Law 1004 of 2005, enabling a reduced 25% income tax rate and certain VAT/customs benefits; (ii) authorization as an electronic invoicer through DIAN's 'Habilitación' process; (iii) contractual revenue-collection arrangements or consortium/joint-venture agreements that may be treated as transparent for income tax and VAT under the Código de Comercio; and (iv) voluntary advance transfer-pricing agreements with DIAN. Hybrid mismatch elections are not generally available; Colombian law applies statutory anti-abuse provisions and controlled foreign corporation rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis turnover threshold applies to exporters or to companies performing taxable operations; VAT registration is mandatory upon commencing taxable activities. Under Article 499 of the Colombian Tax Code only 'pequeños comerciantes' (small merchants) with gross income below the annually indexed UVT-based threshold and without import/export operations may be excluded from the VAT-responsible regime. The threshold is approximately 3,500 UVT (around COP 164.7 million for tax year 2024), but exporters of goods are always VAT-responsible.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All SAS taxpayers, including exporters, must issue electronic invoices through DIAN-authorized software or direct web-service integration with Muisca. Invoice XML files must be transmitted in real time and validated by DIAN before delivery; each invoice must contain the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or, where applicable, CUDS (Código Único de Documentos Soporte), and must be digitally signed. Exports require the electronic invoice to be transmitted with the customs export code and the CUFE, without printing prenumbered paper forms. DIAN mandates full software habilitación, periodic transmission of 'sellados' and final data, and the use of the Single Foreign Trade Window (VUCE) for ancillary export documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods are treated as zero-rated (excluded from IVA with entitlement to input VAT credit) if: (i) the exporter is registered as a VAT-responsible SAS in the RUT; (ii) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory and an accepted export declaration (DEX/Formulario Único de Aduanas) evidences the dispatch; (iii) the commercial invoice expressly states the 0% IVA rate or the legal exclusion basis and carries the CUFE; (iv) the exporter presents the shipping document (Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR); and (v) the foreign currency proceeds are repatriated in accordance with Colombian exchange regulations within 180 calendar days. The zero-rating right includes refund or offset of input VAT attributable to exported goods; failure to complete actual exportation may cause reclassification as a domestic taxable sale.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX/Formulario Único de Aduanas)
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill/CMR transport document)
Inward Remittance Certificate or Certificado de Cambio (Formulario No. 2) evidencing foreign-currency repatriation
Suppliers' VAT invoices supporting refundable input VAT
Packing list and certificate of dispatch (certificado de embarque)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit export transactions for up to five years, scrutinizing the Movement of Merchandise, foreign-exchange repatriation records, and physical shipment evidence. If zero-rating or the VAT credit refund is claimed without a real export, DIAN will recharacterize the transaction as a domestic sale subject to 19% VAT, claw back all VAT credits or refunds, and assess moratory interest. A penalty for 'inexactitud' under Article 648 of the Colombian Tax Code may reach up to 100% of the tax difference. Where customs documents are found false or goods do not exit, the matter may also be treated as smuggling under Customs Law and Law 1762 of 2015, leading to seizures, fines, and criminal prosecution of the legal representative and directors; willful evasion may result in imprisonment and disqualification from exercising trade and tax benefits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank of Colombia), acting through its Junta Directiva, which issues the Colombian foreign exchange regime under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and Resolución 4 de 2023 (Régimen Cambiario, compiling the former Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83). Operational supervision and FX enforcement are shared with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for authorized intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, 'IMCs') and with the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for exchange-control violation penalties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed free-market convertibility regime. Current-account transactions (goods, services, transfers, and investment income such as dividends and interest) are freely convertible but must be 'canalizadas' (channeled) through an IMC and reported on the applicable foreign-exchange declaration form; failure to channel constitutes an infracción cambiaria. Capital-account operations, including inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) into an S.A.S., are permitted for non-resident investors without prior authorization, but must be registered with Banco de la República through an IMC using Form 10 within the statutory term (generally four months from the contribution date). Profit and capital repatriation are legally unblocked, provided the underlying FDI is duly registered and all local taxes, including the 7.5% dividend remittance withholding (or 35% when paid out of non-taxed corporate profits), are settled. Practical hurdles are not convertibility-related but administrative: timely Form 10 registration, documentary completeness, and proving the remitter is the registered shareholder.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods (e.g., model kits and components exported under ISIC 3240) must be received in foreign currency and canalizadas through the Colombian foreign exchange market via an IMC within six (6) months from the date of shipment (embarque); extended terms of up to twelve (12) months may be authorized by Banco de la República for certain capital-goods or long-cycle transactions. There is no mandatory conversion ratio into Colombian pesos: the exporter may maintain the proceeds in a foreign-currency account (cuenta en moneda extranjera) held with an IMC, but the funds must be brought into the Colombian FX system and declared on Form 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones de Bienes). Unrecoverable export receivables must be explicitly written off and reported to the IMC within the surrender period to avoid penalties. For export prepayments, the proceeds must be channeled within the six-month term from the date the prepayment is received, and the export must be completed and declared within the same term; any delay requires prior IMC notification and risk of de minimis fines.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Injection / FDI Monitoring Account (USD Foreign-Currency Account) plus COP Operational Current Account; dedicated international treasury desk for Form 10 processing
Capital Escrow / USD Cost Account plus COP Operational Current Account; strong trade finance and commercial LC issuance for raw-material imports
Operational COP Current Account and USD collection account; competitive FX spreads and integrated digital cash-management platform
Operational COP Current Account with USD sub-account; efficient EUR/USD clearing via BBVA Group and competent IMC onboarding
Operational COP Current Account plus USD account; useful for Chile/Brazil trade corridors, but smaller trade-finance appetite for Asian LC flows
Operational COP Current Account and foreign-currency account; part of Grupo Aval, viable as a secondary account but with a narrower FX derivatives menu

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary treasury or capital-injection rail, MEDIUM as a supplementary collection gateway for retail e-commerce (e.g., PayPal). Offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, etc.) are not authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario; they cannot legally provide the Form 10 registration, Form 2 export channeling, or Form 3 import settlements required under Colombian FX law. Using an EMI for cross-border trade proceeds triggers an infracción cambiaria with DIAN fines up to 200% of the transaction value. PayPal is viable only for low-value collector/retail receipts; funds must be periodically swept into the Colombian IMC account and the underlying export proceeds must still be channeled and declared on Form 2. Local SEDPEs (e-money issuers such as Nequi or Daviplata) are permitted only for domestic peso transfers and may not substitute for FX channeling.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian banks generally require the legal representative (Representante Legal) of the S.A.S. to attend a physical client-knowledge interview (entrevista de conocimiento del cliente) at a designated branch (usually Bogotá or Medellín) for the initial onboarding, together with a notarized corporate-account opening request. Remote video-kYC onboarding is accepted by Bancolombia, Davivienda, and BBVA only where the legal representative is a Colombian resident with verifiable local records or where the company already holds an active credit history. For a non-resident director/shareholder structure, the common practice is to grant a general power of attorney (poder general) to a locally resident Colombian attorney or executive; the power must be notarized abroad, apostilled under the 1961 Hague Convention, and registered with the Cámara de Comercio. Full remote account opening for a non-resident sole director without any local physical presence is not commercially available at the Tier-1 banks and would be assessed as LOW viability.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) is a non-resident individual holding the S.A.S. through one or more foreign holding layers, without local operational track record.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certified passport copies of all UBOs; consolidated corporate chart with full ownership percentages; certificate of good standing from the home-country registry; notarized share-register excerpt (libro de registro de accionistas) filed with Cámara de Comercio; sworn source-of-wealth/source-of-funds affidavit supported by audited financial statements or personal bank references from an investment-grade foreign bank; UBO declaration in compliance with SFC Chapter 4 (SAGRLAFT) and Law 2155 of 2021.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Corporate purpose and physical-plant mismatch: manufacturing scope (high-precision steel injection molding) with no lease, machinery, or local employees at onboarding stage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Industrial warehouse lease agreement (typically exceeding 300 m² with power capacity suitable for injection molding); proforma invoices or purchase orders for injection-molding machines and auxiliary chillers; DIAN import declarations (Form 3) for machinery; utility bills; social-security and payroll registration plan (ARL, EPS, pension); property and machinery insurance policies; photographic or video evidence of the production site and signed supplier contracts for resin/steel feedstock.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Immediate inbound SWIFT capital injection followed by urgent outbound trade disbursements to Asian suppliers (tooling and resin), before the company shows operating revenue.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized board minutes of the S.A.S. approving the CAPEX and working-capital budget; detailed 12-month treasury forecast; executed purchase agreements/proforma invoices from independent third-party suppliers (e.g., tooling shops in China and polymer distributors); corporate treasury policy signed by management; Colombian tax registration (RUT) and municipal ICA registration; Cámara de Comercio certificate showing permitted object (ISIC 3240).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of PayPal and other e-commerce collection rails, which banks may flag as layering risk for a B2B manufacturer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed brand-license or distribution agreements for the anime/collector line revealing retail e-commerce sales channels; PayPal business-account registration documents; written internal reconciliation policy evidencing periodic sweeps of PayPal balances to the local IMC account with matching Form 2 declarations; customer invoicing and shipping documentation (HS codes, bill of lading, DIAN export declarations); periodic customer and sales-report files demonstrating low per-transaction retail values consistent with hobby collecting.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder wires the equity contribution via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank-level value) to the S.A.S.'s USD-denominated account at the selected IMC. The MT103 instruction must reference the beneficiary's NIT (tax ID), the corporate name 'CO_SAS', and the payment purpose in English and Spanish, e.g., 'Aporte de Capital – Inversión Directa / Equity Contribution – Formulario 10 FDI Registration', to prevent unclassified inflow treatment. Within four (4) months from the effective contribution date, the IMC files Form 10 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) with Banco de la República on behalf of the investor, issuing the FDI registration certificate. Disbursement of the capital amount into the operational COP account is performed at the market FX rate (TRM) of the settlement date; alternatively, the proceeds remain in the USD account to make foreign payments directly. The bank's compliance desk verifies that the remitting account belongs to the registered shareholder; remittances from unaffiliated third-party accounts will be rejected. If capital is contributed in-kind (machinery), the customs import declaration, DIAN appraisal, and notarized contribution minutes must support the Form 10 filing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For overseas suppliers of polymer resins, steel, pigments, mold tooling, and packaging, the standard clearing rails are: (i) open-account SWIFT MT103 payments, executed on the IMC online channel against commercial invoices and proforma purchase orders, with debit to the COP or USD account and same-day Form 3 import declaration; (ii) documentary collections (D/P or D/A) through the IMC's correspondent network; and (iii) commercial letters of credit (LC) at sight or usance, issued under ICC UCP 600 rules, denominated in USD and typically requiring 100% cash collateral or an approved credit line at the issuing Colombian bank. Import payments must be channeled through the IMC within the statutory term (generally six months following customs clearance; pre-payments are allowed provided Form 3 is filed no later than the month of disbursement). Outbound payments to non-suppliers such as royalties, agent commissions, and dividends are declared under Form 4 and subject to applicable withholding taxes. All export collections from North American, European, and Asian distributors must be channeled through the IMC on Form 2 within the six-month surrender period to remain compliant.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD Deliverable Forwards (forwards con entrega) contracted with an IMC, tenors typically 1 to 12 months, settled on the agreed exchange rate with physical delivery or net settlement, subject to underlying exposure documentation.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP with tenors up to 24 months, used for hedged positions when the bank restricts physical delivery or when the counterparty is offshore; execution requires compliance with Resolución 4 de 2023 and demonstration of real trade or financial exposure.

Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) coupling USD-denominated external debt or capital instruments with COP floating or fixed legs, permitted for hedging long-term balance-sheet exposure at tenors up to 10 years.

Plain-vanilla FX options (USD/COP calls and puts) purchased through an IMC, used to cap adverse exchange-rate moves on import or export cash flows while retaining upside, with premium payments declared under the FX regime.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Bogotá) jointly with DIAN for UBO declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each fiscal year (no NIT foolproof; fixed date for all merchants)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment fine of up to 2% of the registration fee for each month of delay; after 3 consecutive years of non-renewal, administrative strike-off (cancelación de la matrícula) and loss of commercial capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income and complementary tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementario, Formulario 210)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between 5 and 12 August of the following fiscal year, according to the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 1% of the tax due per month or fraction (not less than 5% nor more than 200% of the assessed tax) plus default interest at 1.5% per month; repeat failure may trigger tax register suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual financial statements (Estados Financieros, informe de gestión) with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (in accordance with Law 222 of 1995)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the shareholders' meeting approving the financial statements, and in all cases before 31 March of the following fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary fines by the Superintendence of Companies and cancellation of the commercial registration if filed after the 31 March final deadline; possible imposition of personal liability for administrators.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal industry and commerce tax return (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio – ICA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury (Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda of the jurisdiction where the company operates)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the first quarter of the following fiscal year (January to April, per municipal schedule and NIT ending digit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment penalties early up to 15% of the tax due, plus default interest; persistent non-filing may lead to administrative seizure and municipal collection action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory under Article 203 of the Código de Comercio and Article 22 of Law 1258 of 2008 if at the prior year-end any of the following conditions are met: (i) more than 30 employees; (ii) total assets exceed 5,000 tax-value units (UVT) – approximately COP 190 million (USD ~47,000) for FY2024; (iii) gross annual income exceeds 10,000 UVT – approximately COP 380 million (USD ~95,000). The UVT is adjusted annually by the DIAN.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (CFRS) issued under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 3022 of 2013, fully converged to IFRS for SMEs (Group 2). For entities exceeding the Group 1 consideration thresholds, full IFRS (Decree 2941 of 2013) applies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: During the annual commercial registration renewal (before 31 March), the SAS must confirm or update the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) with DIAN and the Chamber of Commerce. The confirmation includes direct and indirect shareholdings, and identifies every individual with a final beneficial interest of 10% or more or exercising control. Any change during the year (e.g., share transfer, new ownership structure) must be reported within 30 calendar days after the due diligence is concluded; failures trigger fines under DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2022.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Socios) – must be kept at the registered office and contain all share transfers and pledges.

Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva) – maintained only if the SAS has either a board of directors or an individual legal representative; otherwise the register is limited to directors' appointments.
Minute Book (Libro de Actas) – contains shareholders' meeting minutes, unanimous written consents, and board meeting records.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 – USD 1,200 per year depending on the city and service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 5,000 for a small to mid-sized manufacturer under IFRS for SMEs

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No tax holiday is specific to ISIC 3240. General preferences include the 25% income tax credit for certified research, technology and innovation (CTI) investments, and a 20% preferential rate for entities operating under a legal Free Zone license. Plastic mecha model kit exports are not granted a statutory export tax holiday.
